False merge on the title 'core knowledge'. Survivor is Spelke 2000 (single-author, American Psychologist, DOI 10.1037/0003-066x.55.11.1233). The pulled-in member spelke2007core is Spelke & Kinzler 2007 in Developmental Science with a DIFFERENT DOI (10.1111/j.1467-7687.2007.00569.x) — different authors, year, journal, and DOI. Two separate works.
